Site Text.Name: about_history
Site Text.Text:
Fargo Tire Service has been locally owned and operated since it opened in 1950.

Duane "Andy" Anderson bought the business in 1972. In 1978 the retread department added a new curing chamber, and in 1979 a new building doubled the alignment department to four bays with computerized alignment machines.

Andy's sons, Paul and Roger, joined the business in 1988 and have led the team ever since.
